test_groups.name: unresolved_default_has_one_conditional_hint_without_creating_a_factory
test_groups.expectation: Six result types (Bit, Unit, Q<Bit>, Q<Unit>, Q<Bits<0>>, nested product), an unused generic Basis body and an ill-typed not-q argument keep identical unresolved-default messages, common name / finite unknown_name categories and exact original callee byte spans. Unicode/CRLF prefix remains accountable. An unrelated missing function keeps its exact old unhinted message. The hint is name-level, not a claim that these arguments were evaluated or that any default trait exists.

test_groups.name: resolved_user_defaults_keep_ordinary_bodies_and_explicit_preparation
test_groups.expectation: Checked ordinary functions named default return ordinary Bit/Unit with Unitary effect; ordinary Unit is reusable. A checked default explicitly calling init0 has principal Iso, retained transitively by its caller, and gets native finite acceptance. A generic Basis identity named default transfers its one input owner with Unitary effect. A runtime local named default retains exact local-not-callable category/message/span and no unresolved-default hint.

test_groups.name: false_unitary_assertions_cannot_hide_default_named_preparation
test_groups.expectation: Direct Unitary assertion on the preparing default and transitive Unitary assertion on its caller reject with effect category at the actual init0/default call span. Existing semantic externally-unitary-not-supported explanation remains, without GitHub references or unresolved-name hints.

test_groups.name: explicit_unit_maps_do_not_make_zero_width_owners_ordinary_defaults
test_groups.expectation: A user default explicitly using unit(()) and a caller using finish(default()) pass common source judgment and selected elaboration with Unitary effect. Ordinary () does not implicitly construct Q<Unit>. The default name cannot excuse abandoned nested quantum ownership, a wildcard drop or duplicate use of Q<Unit>; their type/ownership categories and original spans remain checked.
